semantic_identity: Open-front Clockwork miniature workshop with exposed boiler and workbench
intended_function: Present a usable Clockwork production building whose machinery and work area remain visible at settlement distance.

citizen_scale.ratio_or_view: 20-inch building height is 40 half-inch citizen-heights; use the supplied dimensions and a schematic rather than generated people.

silhouette_requirements: Compact stone plinth and joined timber frame.
Raised narrow ridge canopy supported by visible trusses.
Boiler stack, copper pipe, gauge, flywheel and workbench visible from the front three-quarter view.

construction_materials.construction: Fitted stone blocks with restrained seams.
Joined oak posts, braces, bench, tool rail and board wall.
construction_materials.material: Warm worn oak and dark stained timber.

construction_materials.construction: Raised narrow ridge roof on explicit timber trusses, set back enough not to cover machinery.
Riveted pressure shell, separate flanges, exposed wheel and connected pipe runs.
construction_materials.material: Sooty iron, aged copper, and restrained brass.

art_direction: Clockwork: tactile miniature industrial construction with readable wood, stone, iron and copper.
gameplay_distance_readability: At settlement scale, keep the boiler, tall stack, flywheel and open-front workshop role visible; don't let the canopy or roof hide the machinery.

visual_references.provenance: Actual Godot production render; closed roof hides machinery.
Selected raised-canopy concept from a three-way image comparison; Luna pixel review.
Exact ArtBrief dimensions at 12 SVG pixels per inch; 0.5-inch citizen shown as a 6-pixel marker.

prohibited_failure_modes: Do not hide the boiler, gauge, flywheel or workbench behind the roof.
No disconnected roof or unsupported overhang.
Do not remove the live workshop gear/steam contract.
Do not change the 26 x 20 x 20 inch envelope, RoomDefinition landmarks or activity stations.
roomdefinition_authority: ArtBrief dimensions are 26 x 20 x 20 inches. RoomDefinition owns workshop location, activity stations, collision, navigation and gameplay state; rendering geometry remains presentation only.
separate_room_assets: RoomDefinition workshop interactions and activity stations
steam emitter and production-owned animation nodes
